Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_TwoHandReq_toolt: Restrict multi hit to weapons designed for two hands. Item whitelist entries bypass this filter.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_RangeBool_toolti: Limit weapons below the configured maximum-range threshold to one target.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_RangeNum_tooltip: Used when the range filter is enabled. A weapon exactly at this threshold is eligible.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_StrReq_tooltip: Below this level, melee attacks and shoves hit at most one target, including whitelisted items.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_FitReq_tooltip: Below this level, melee attacks and shoves hit at most one target, including whitelisted items.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_SkillReq_tooltip: Use the equipped weapon's own B42 skill. Shoves do not require a weapon skill. Zero disables the requirement.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_MaxHitCap_toolti: Zero keeps the Vanilla maximum. A positive value reduces eligible melee and shove target counts; it never adds targets.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_Axe_tooltip: Allow multi hit for the B42 axe category, subject to the other requirements.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_LongBlunt_toolti: Allow multi hit for the B42 long blunt category, subject to the other requirements.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_SmallBlunt_toolt: Allow multi hit for the B42 short blunt category, subject to the other requirements.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_LongBlade_toolti: Allow multi hit for the B42 long blade category, subject to the other requirements.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_SmallBlade_toolt: Allow multi hit for the B42 short blade category, subject to the other requirements.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_Spear_tooltip: Allow multi hit for the B42 spear category, subject to the other requirements.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_Unarmed_tooltip: Allow Vanilla shove multi hit when Vanilla permits it. The default Base.BareHands whitelist bypasses this category switch.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_Whitelist_toolti: Exact full item types separated by semicolons. Overrides item filters and blacklist entries; character requirements and the hit cap still apply. Base.BareHands identifies shoves.
Sandbox_MultiHitLimiter_Blacklist_toolti: Exact full item types separated by semicolons. Listed items hit one target unless also whitelisted. Whitespace around each entry is ignored.
